title: The proportion of polynomials over F_2 with positive orthogonal multiplicity
summary: Let A = F_2[T]. The orthogonal multiplicity m(f) of a monic f in A of degree d >= 1 is the number of g in A with deg g 0 behaves as d tends to infinity.
